description.value: Ton Khao Thai Cuisine is a family-run restaurant in Historic Downtown Abbotsford, owned by Suthin and Ya, offering an extensive menu of Thai street-food classics spanning curries, noodles, stir-fries, and grills. Dishes are built around the five traditional Thai flavour pillars — sweet, sour, salty, spicy, and creamy — with adjustable spice levels from none to Thai hot. Cyclists passing through downtown Abbotsford will find both dine-in and call-ahead takeout service.
